lesson_title: Your Family Paid for Everything Without Touching Money
hook_text: This month your family probably paid for almost everything without touching a single coin.
clip_script: Payday. No envelope, no cash. The salary arrives by EFT, just numbers going up. Saturday: tap the debit card, groceries paid in two seconds. The electricity token? Bought on the app. Rent? EFT. School trip? Sent to the teacher's cellphone number. Welcome to electronic banking: real money travelling as information. It is fast and safer than cash. But then an SMS says your account is blocked, click here. Stop. Banks never ask for your PIN or one-time PIN. That is phishing. Coin or app, money still does the same four jobs: buy, compare, save and pay later.
visual_style: A whiteboard phone screen with a balance ticking up and down, arrows to a supermarket, a meter, a landlord's house and a big red X over a scam SMS.
mood: Modern and slightly suspenseful, with a scam twist.
pacing: Quick-fire payments, a pause on the scam message, then a calm summary.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and teach someone at home the never-share-your-PIN rule.
